Hi 智皓,

Pleas try:

# title: confidence interval for regression model
# date: 2014.3.23
x <- c (39.00, 37.50, 22.20, 17.50, 0.64, 0.45, 2.62, 2.36, 32.00, 0.77)
y <- c (23.00, 22.30, 9.40, 9.70, 0.15, 0.28, 0.75, 0.51, 28.00, 0.39)
mydata <- data.frame(x,y)
attach(mydata)
mydata.lm <- lm(y ~ x)
new <- data.frame(x=12)
pred.interval <- predict(mydata.lm, new, interval="confidence")
pred.interval[2:3]
# end
